title: Swift Rapid NGS Part 1 - Reverse Transcription
author: Opentrons
materials: Samples are then moved to the magnetic module.
Magnetic beads are added to samples.
Samples are incubated at room temperature.
Plate is placed back on magnetic module.
Low EDTA TE is added to beads, incubate.
Mastermix added to samples, plate spun down.

steps.title: Prepare RT Mastermix (4 °C)
steps.instruction: Make the Reverse Transcription Mastermix on the Opentrons Aluminum 24‑tube rack and keep it at 4 °C.

steps.title: Distribute and mix Mastermix
steps.instruction: Dispense the RT Mastermix into each sample well and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Run RT thermocycler program
steps.instruction: Place the plate in a thermocycler and run the prescribed Reverse Transcription temperature profile.

steps.title: Move plate to magnetic module
steps.instruction: Transfer the plate from the thermocycler to the magnetic module.

steps.title: Add magnetic beads
steps.instruction: Add the magnetic beads to each sample well.

steps.title: Incubate at room temperature
steps.instruction: Allow the bead‑sample mixture to sit at room temperature for the indicated time.

steps.title: Pause – remove, seal, spin
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol, remove the plate from the deck, seal it, and spin down.

steps.title: Return plate to magnetic module
steps.instruction: Place the sealed, spun plate back onto the magnetic module.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard the supernatant from each well while the magnet is engaged.

steps.title: Two ethanol washes (30 s)
steps.instruction: Perform two ethanol washes, each followed by a 30‑second incubation, then remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Pause – remove, seal, spin
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol, remove the plate from the deck, seal it, and spin down.

steps.title: Add Low‑EDTA TE
steps.instruction: Add Low EDTA TE buffer to the beads and incubate for the specified time.

steps.title: Pause – remove, seal, spin
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol, remove the plate from the deck, seal it, and spin down.

steps.title: Repeat bead cleanup (steps 5‑13)
steps.instruction: Perform a second round of steps 5 through 13.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to columns 9‑11
steps.instruction: Move the cleared supernatant into columns 9, 10, and 11.

steps.title: Prepare Ligation Mastermix (4 °C)
steps.instruction: Make the Ligation Mastermix on the Opentrons Aluminum 24‑tube rack and keep it at 4 °C.

steps.title: Add ligation Mastermix and spin
steps.instruction: Add the Ligation Mastermix to each sample and spin the plate down.

steps.title: Run ligation thermocycler program
steps.instruction: Place the plate in a thermocycler and run the ligation temperature profile.
